claims.statement: Accepting an individual assignment creates a new repository for that student, with empty or template-based content containing starter code, docs, tests and resources. Each repository is owned by the teacher's organization account, not the student's personal account. Creation semantics do not prove actual permissions, accepted identity, safe code or template licensing.

Clearing current search, filters and sorts is optional and resets the assignment overview's view state. It does not delete assignments or student records, certify a complete assessment population or establish that all records were displayed.
Selecting the intended assignment in a list opens its view. List selection is contextual navigation, not assignment identity verification, access authorization or a reviewed submission.
Selecting the intended classroom in a list opens its view. A display selection does not establish durable tenant identity, membership or permission to modify the classroom.

The Settings tab under the classroom name is contextual navigation with a decorative gear icon. The Markdown screenshot caption identifies an orange-highlighted Settings tab and references click-settings.png; the raster was not inspected and receives no inherited asset-review receipt. No settings were changed.

The Students tab under the classroom name is contextual navigation with a decorative people icon. Its screenshot caption describes an orange-highlighted Students tab and references click-students.png; the image and any actual roster remain unreviewed. No student records were accessed.
